tutorial.name: Student
tutorial.text: Thanks! I am ready to learn.

story1.text: "At the end of every civilization, the Archive arrives."
Wake up, Executioner. We have visitors.

story1.name: You
story1.text: (Ugh… My head… I still haven't recovered fully from the last mission).

story1.name: You
story1.text: Hello, Senior Archivist Miller. What flavor of visitors do we have on our hands?

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: As you know, there are only 2 types of people who seek out the Archive. People whose world has not yet been archived, desperate for knowledge of when their world will, and people whose world has already met its end. This one is the latter.

story1.name: You
story1.text: I'm guessing they're the violent type?

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Precisely.

story1.name: You
story1.text: Well, Senior Archivist, I'm gonna need your assistance with this one. My motor skills and mind are in shambles after that last mission.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Fine, but follow exactly what I say.

story1.name: You
story1.text: Alright! Let's do this.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Attention. It seems we are facing off against a Gooney.

story1.name: You
story1.text: Gooney? Man, they really need to come up with better names.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: You can see your available cards at the bottom. Most cards cost energy. It's the number in the yellow circle. Your energy is located above your head. You gain 1 energy every turn.

story1.name: You
story1.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Why did you ask me to help then?

story1.name: You
story1.text: Memory doesn't come easily with concussions, y'know.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Hmm… alright. Your deck is at the bottom right. You draw a new card from your deck at the start of your turn.

story1.name: You
story1.text: What's that icon in the top corner?

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Right, I almost forgot.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Your cards have different damage types. Some enemies have weaknesses to certain damage types, choose wisely when fighting.
